rationale: No displayed earlier directive provides a concrete, material drafting template for the child's seven-item schedule of statutory deadline extensions. C23 is strongest because it also revises multiple legally prescribed time limitations, but it does so by replacing an award-regulation paragraph and uses materially different proviso-based machinery. C21 changes an order's expiration dates, but the resemblance is limited to extending dates. C06 concerns housing administration and the same named housing administrator, yet it transfers functions and terminates an office rather than extending statutory deadlines. These similarities are topical, functional, or routine rather than evidence of reused drafting.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The time stipulated in subsection (c) of section 601 of the Act ... is extended from December 31, 1950, to December 31, 1951.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the said decoration may be awarded not later than May 2, 1952, in any case in which the written recommendation therefor shall have been made on or before May 2, 1951
shared_material.explanation: C23 likewise alters legal time limits, but it lacks the child's repeated 'time stipulated ... is extended from ... to ...' formulation and uses a replacement regulatory paragraph.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The time stipulated ... is extended from ... to ...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall cease to be effective on March 31, 1950; Provided, however ... it shall continue in effect until June 30, 1950.
shared_material.explanation: C21 extends the operation of an order, but this is generic date-extension machinery and does not parallel the child's sequence of statute-specific deadlines.

shared_material.child_excerpt: temporary housing remaining under the jurisdiction of the Housing and Home Finance Administrator
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall be administered through the Housing and Home Finance Agency
shared_material.explanation: C06 shares the housing-administration setting and agency terminology, but its operative structure and legal action are substantially different.
